prompts.crimson: Use case: stylized-concept. Final production background for a premium 2D arcade fighting game, original intricately hand-pixelled 1990s arcade art. EXTREMELY WIDE panoramic image 1792x768 (7:3 aspect ratio). Side-on fighting-game camera, camera eye level, no tilted horizon. Masterfully detailed environment with hundreds of small authored details, layered atmospheric perspective, dark colored outlines, crisp pixel clusters and 4-6 tone ramps, NOT flat geometric vector art, NOT 3D, NOT blurry painting. No characters or fighters, no UI, no text labels, no logos. Composition constraint: flat walkable fighting platform spans the ENTIRE width, its BACK EDGE is a perfectly straight horizontal line at precisely y=619 (80.6% of image height). Floor fills y=619..768 and must be unobstructed, with no foreground objects hiding fighters. Scenery and props stay behind this line. Keep the central lower zone y=440..619 moderately dark and visually calm so fighters stand out, reserve brighter details for upper and outer areas. Rich elaborate background with beautiful pixel rendering, purposeful lighting and mood. SCENE: CRIMSON CASTLE at night in Japan. A magnificent feudal castle courtyard beneath a luminous full moon, overlapping mountain silhouettes and wisps of mist. A large multi-tier castle with tiled roofs showing individual roof tiles, carved wooden eaves, golden shachi ornaments, stone ramparts with detailed interlocking masonry, warm glowing paper windows with fine latticework. Weathered red torii gate at far left, stone lanterns with tiny fire chambers, thick cherry trees with knotted bark and thousands of individual pink blossoms framing both edges, scattered petals in stone gutters, hanging silk banners, distant shrine rooftops, a red wooden bridge and dark reflective moat. Beautiful restrained indigo, mulberry, scarlet, warm gold and pale pink palette. Floor is aged uneven-looking but flat stone paving with moss, hairline cracks, worn engraved crest, petals, subtle moonlit edges, no huge perspective grid. Rich intricate arcade pixel-art storytelling.
